entrance: The Scarlet Monastery at the eastern end of Tirisfal Glades, at /way 85.1 31.4. Each wing has its own door; this one is open to everyone.

1113.objective: Collect 20 Hearts of Zeal from the Scarlet Crusade.
1113.note: They drop from Scarlet bosses and monsters in all four wings. The quest follows Going, Going, Guano! from Razorfen Kraul.

1051.objective: Bring the wedding ring of Vorrel Sengutz to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.
1051.note: Vorrel is held in the room of Interrogator Vishas.
